app.tagline: Your pantry, sorted by your market.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to your household.
login.demoHint: No sign-up. A sample household with 35 products.
login.demoFailed: The demo is not available right now.

list.title: Shopping list
list.noProducts: Every product is already on the list
list.routeEmpty: Nothing on your route. Check the whole list.
list.notFoundMeta: Not found · moves to the next list
list.splitHint: Each person gets a block of neighboring corridors, balanced by number of items. You take the first ones.
list.leaveText: Every item stays on the list. What was checked goes back to unchecked.
list.movesNext_one: {{count}} item moves to your next list.
list.movesNext_other: {{count}} items move to your next list.
list.cartEmpty: The cart is empty: nothing will be added to your stock.
list.carried_one: {{count}} item moved to your next list
list.carried_other: {{count}} items moved to your next list
list.changedElsewhere: The list changed on another phone. It is up to date now.
list.finishedElsewhere: The shopping was finished on another phone.
list.estimatedFromLast: Estimated from the last prices. Add the real ones later in History.
list.withPlan: Floor plan · list in walking order
list.elsewhereHint: No plan: the list goes by category

tour.tapHint: Tap the highlighted spot to continue.
tour.samProgress: Sam is picking his items… {{done}} of {{total}}
tour.samSync: Sam's ticks are on their way to this phone…

list-card.title: Your shopping list
list-card.text: Everything that runs low lands here on its own: how many items, how many ran out, and about how much they will cost.

fridge.title: Your home, by area
fridge.text: Each ring shows how stocked an area is. Open the Fridge.

use.title: Used something? One tap.
use.text: Finished a liter of milk? Tap Use. That is all Cella asks of you at home, and it can be undone.

to-list.title: Already on the list
to-list.text: The milk reached its minimum, so it went onto the shopping list by itself. Open the list.

corridors.title: In the order of your market
corridors.text: Items are grouped by the corridors of your market, in the order you walk them. No going back for the milk.

start.title: At the market
start.text: When you arrive, tap Start shopping. The list becomes a checklist.

check.title: One tap per item
check.text: Tap an item when it goes into the cart. Tap again to take it out.

split.title: Shopping together?
split.text: Split the route with Sam: open the menu, choose Split the route, then Split. Each person gets a block of neighboring corridors.

two-phones.title: Now, both phones
two-phones.text: Sam has his own phone. Let's put them side by side and watch the list stay in sync.

everyone.title: Follow Sam
everyone.text: Your route has only your corridors. Open Everyone to see Sam's part too.

sam.title: Sam is shopping too
sam.text: Watch his items get ticked here, on your phone. Nobody buys the same thing twice.

finish.title: All done
finish.text: Tap Finish shopping, then Finish. What is in the cart goes into your stock; what was missing moves to the next list.

receipt.title: Prices from the receipt
receipt.text: At home, add the receipt: each line is matched to a product and its price is saved. In this demo it is a sample receipt; with a real account, a photo is read by Claude.

receipt-review.title: Check, then save
receipt-review.text: Arrows show how each price moved since last time. Nothing is saved until you confirm: tap Save prices.

end.title: That's Cella
end.text: Your pantry, sorted by your market. Keep exploring: this copy of the demo is yours for the next 24 hours.

demo.title: Alex and Sam, at the same market
demo.subtitle: Two phones, one list. What one person ticks shows up on the other within 3 seconds.

hints.brand: Optional: the one you usually buy
hints.category: Decides the corridor in the market
hints.step: What one tap on Use removes
hints.minimum: At or below this, it goes on the list
hints.ideal: The list buys up to this

errors.name: Give it a name.
errors.number: A number, zero or more (up to 3 decimals).
errors.minAboveIdeal: The minimum cannot be above the ideal.

markets.summary: The market you choose sorts your shopping list by its corridors.
markets.empty: No markets yet. Add the one where you shop.

plan.title: Floor plan
plan.layoutHint: Drag to move · drag the corner to resize · Shift + click selects several · arrows move, Shift + arrows resize
plan.routeHint: Tap the corridors in the order you walk them
plan.orderHint: The shopping list follows this order. Tap the corridors on the plan to choose it yourself.
plan.howText: Add aisles, walls and islands, drag them into place and select one to name it and choose its categories. The route follows a zigzag from the entrance.
plan.notAStop: Start or end of the route
plan.name: Name
plan.nameTaken: Each piece needs its own name.
plan.unplacedHint: These show up as "Other", at the end of the list. Select a corridor, then tap one to put it there.
plan.noRoom: No room left: make the market bigger first.
plan.blocked: No room to rotate it there.
plan.leaveText: Your changes to the floor plan will be lost.
plan.sizeLabel: {{cols}} × {{rows}} cells · + and − on each edge resize it

top.name: Top edge
top.add: Add a row at the top

bottom.name: Bottom edge
bottom.add: Add a row at the bottom

left.name: Left edge
left.add: Add a column on the left

right.name: Right edge
right.add: Add a column on the right

receipt.title: Prices from the receipt
receipt.intro: Take a photo of the receipt: Claude reads each line and matches it to your products. You check everything before it is saved.
receipt.privacy: The photo is not stored, only the prices you confirm.
receipt.readError: Could not read this receipt. Try another photo, or use the sample.
receipt.sampleHint: In the demo, the receipt is a sample made from what you bought. Each line is matched to a product; the arrows show how the price moved since last time.
receipt.reviewHint: Each line was matched to a product. Fix any match or price, then save.
receipt.missing_one: {{names}} has no line and keeps its last price.
receipt.missing_other: {{count}} products have no line and keep their last price: {{names}}.
receipt.repeated: {{names}} is on more than one line: pick one.
receipt.invalid: Some prices are not valid numbers.
receipt.saveError: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
receipt.updatesPrices: Saved prices become each product's last price, so the next list is estimated with them.
receipt.savedNote: Paid, from the receipt. Prices updated.

used.title: Used this week
used.none: Nothing used in the last 7 days.

history.title: History
history.empty: No purchases yet. They show up here after each checkout.

source.ai: Prices read from the receipt photo.

invite.title: Invite to {{household}}
invite.text: Whoever opens the link creates an account and shares this home: the stock, the list and the shopping route.
invite.demo: This is a demo copy that is deleted after 24 hours, so nobody can join it. In a real household, this link adds a person to your home.

join.title: Join a household
join.text: You were invited to share a home on Cella. Create your account to start.
join.name: Your name
join.passwordShort: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
join.codeNotFound: This invite code does not exist. Check it with whoever invited you.
join.emailTaken: There is already an account with this email.
join.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
